title: From before the ages He willed me and now may not will me away or ever.
html_source:
By divine provenance Stephen is created.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Stephen believes that artists are “made” and not “begotten” and therefore he imagines his own birth to have been willed by God.

This allows Stephen to distance himself from his biological parents, who in doing the “coupler’s will”, were also doing God’s will, and thus abiding by the lex eterna.

From “‘Strandentwining Cable’: Joyce, Flaubert, and Intertextuality” by Scarlett Baron
